messages:
Devon: quick follow-up thread for Raven onprem outage — collecting owners and timelines. Main buckets: VPC peering flaps, on-prem appliance MTU/kernel constraints, and the tenant isolation bug that surfaced during failover. I'll own the document/timeline.
Ajay: I can pick up network pinning + peering config changes. Will open a PR with config and a short runbook. ETA: EOW. @Devon can you attach the peering diag logs to the PM?
Devon: added traceroutes and BGP dumps to GH-4123 and the postmortem draft. link: https://internal.redwood/gh/4123 (attachments: bgp-dump.tar.gz, trace-logs.txt)
Priya: on the appliance side we're consistently seeing MTU mismatch traces and TCP retrans of mid-sized payloads. Reproducing with a local VM / pcap shows path MTU discovery failing.
Sam (support): contacted Raven SRE, they agreed to packet captures tomorrow 10:00 PST. I'll gather consent and share S3 link once uploaded.
SRE-Bot: Incident #RAV-2023-09-21 updated: postmortem draft created. PM doc: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/raven-onprem (auto-note)
Maria: product ask: for isolation safety, propose a routing guardrail so dedicated requests can fail-open to hosted backend when VPC peer is down for >30s. Need product sign-off and an A/B plan.
Ajay: I'll prototype a lightweight fallback policy: route->preferred: dedicated, fallback: hosted-fallback. Prototype config + metrics 10% canary by next Tue.
Priya: owners/tasks summary (what I have):
- Ajay: routing fallback prototype and canary (target 2023-11-07)
- Devon: postmortem doc + weekly status compile
- Maria: product approval + A/B criteria
- Sam: Raven packet captures + scheduling with CSM
- Meena: QA harness for MTU/discovery tests in infra-ci
- Eng-Infra (TBD): recurring peering health job for Dedicated customers (detect MTU asymmetry within 24h)
Meena: I'll add MTU and PMTUD tests to the onprem CI bucket. ETA next Thu. Will add flaky-tolerance thresholds.
Devon: small diag snippet I pasted into the doc for context:
```
# captured during failure window
14:22:31.123 IP 10.0.0.5 > 192.168.1.1: ICMP frag needed, mtu 1400
14:22:31.125 TCP 10.0.0.5.443 > 192.168.1.11: Flags [P.], seq 123:567, ack 45, win 29200
```
Priya: exact reproduction steps are in the draft; we should also run the same against a VM that simulates Raven's middlebox (their appliance firmware).
Ajay: I'll create ticket INF-8812 for the healthcheck + alerting rule (probing path MTU and BGP neighbor flaps). Assigning to eng-infra; ETA: 2 weeks.
Sam (support): CSM update: Raven's on-site maintenance window ok on 2023-11-09 02:00-04:00 UTC. Sam will coordinate reboot and capture.
Maria: product question: if we route to hosted fallback, what are the auth/tenant implications? We need to ensure tokens and model pinning still respect isolation SLA. I'll review with security.
Devon: good point — add security review to the tasks, Maria please loop in security. Also we should add a post-deploy sanity check that validates tenant isolation invariants after fallback is enabled.
Priya: note for owners: the isolation bug was triggered when the peering flapped and our KV cache eviction coincided with model reloads. That correlation needs a root-cause note in the PM.
Meena: I'll add an e2e that simulates peering flap + cache eviction to validate behavior.
Ajay: quick config example for fallback proto: `routing { prefer: dedicated; fallback: hosted-fallback; timeout_ms: 30000 }` — metrics: fallback_rate, latency_delta, error_rate.
Devon: action: please react with :eyes: on the message where you have ownership. I'll compile into PM and create JIRA tickets Friday.
Maria: :eyes:
Ajay: :eyes:
Priya: :eyes:
Sam (support): :eyes:
Meena: :eyes:
Devon: thanks — unless someone objects I'll move each line into tracked JIRA tasks and ping owners. Will schedule a 30m sync next Tue to review canary plan and MTU test status.
Ajay: fine by me.
Priya: good plan.
Sam (support): confirmed with Raven SRE for capture window.
Devon: closing this thread — if there are new blockers please reopen or ping me directly.
(automated): thread archived to incidents/channel after 7d of inactivity.
